# Opening this example

From the example folder, open the example in the active supported IDE with:

```r
CyneRgy::RunExample( "." )
```

RStudio opens `{{EXAMPLE_NAME}}.Rproj`. VS Code opens the example folder, `Description.Rmd`, and every R script under `R/`.
The R scripts do not require an RStudio project.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library( CyneRgy )
```
